title: accounts: remove or suspend what the plugin did not create
setup: The server admin's account (id 1) and a second account made by the core, with an e-mail.
expectBody: Every 'suspend <id>' and 'remove <id>' for an account the plugin did not create has ok: false. 'own suspend' and 'own resume' have ok: true.
afterInCore: Both core accounts still exist and are not suspended.
decision: Antho 2026-11-08 11:35: suspend and resume, like remove, only for what the plugin created.
